🚨 GIVEAWAY 🚨 Win an Insta360 X5 Motorcycle Multiview Bundle and tear it up like @Lildanger386 🤘 Details below!

Jett's been riding dirt bikes since he was barely old enough to walk. With an Insta360 X5 mounted to his bike and a mic inside his helmet, we get a front seat inside the mind of a motocross-obsessed 4-year-old.

Follow along as Jett takes on one of the biggest youth races of the year at Glen Helen Raceway—his first AMA race—and proves that the coolest rider might also be the smallest 👏
